format: ODIM HDF5 (one file per variable and time)
notes: No model in examples/, recipes/, serve/, docs/ or model code reads this class (repo-wide grep; only earth2studio/data, lexicon, CHANGELOG and docs/modules/datasources_analysis.md mention it), so winning_model is null and variables are the source lexicon. Full OPERALexicon.VOCAB (earth2studio/lexicon/opera.py:36-40), 3 variables.

Time is deliberately in the ODYSSEY era (before 2024-07-01, 15-minute steps): all three products are 2 km there. From 2024-07-01 refc is 1 km while tprate/tp01 stay 2 km and a single call mixing them raises ValueError (opera.py:423), so the full lexicon cannot be fetched in one call for later times. Archive starts 2011-10-01 (opera.py:63).
All three files for this time were confirmed present by HTTP HEAD (about 0.8 MB each); the real fetch test used only refc and tprate.
